response.sql:
SELECT AVG(customer_count) AS average_customers_per_employee
FROM (
  SELECT e.EmployeeId, COUNT(c.CustomerId) AS customer_count
  FROM Employee AS e
  LEFT JOIN Customer AS c ON c.SupportRepId = e.EmployeeId
  GROUP BY e.EmployeeId
) AS employee_customer_counts;

assumptions.assumption: Each employee counts once, including employees with no assigned customers; customers with a NULL or unmatched SupportRepId are not counted.
